reviews.text: Dustin is the best. We had some issues with septic. He figured it out and fixed it. He accesses the problem and finds a solution without breaking the bank. He's reliable, reasonable price and smart. He does great work as well. Very friendly.

reviews.text: Highly recommend you use DEW septic. They will give you honest advice and won't try to sell you on things you don't need.

reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Dustin at DEW Septic, LLC, and couldn’t be happier. Nobody wants to face septic issues two days before the holidays, but that’s when emergencies happen!
